From Limp Bizkit · Price: you need corpses nearby, and the zombies are weak.

Theme Matter and Life

  • 1: 2 actions: raise one @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{invisible} zombie from a corpse within 30 ft (minion, 1 action to command, lasts 1 minute).
  • 5: Two zombies.
  • 9: Surge: zombies deal @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level-1)/4))d6[force]] extra damage, and creatures they hit are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{grabbed}.
  • 13: Four zombies.
  • 17: Zombies can be raised from creatures that died this fight, as creatures of their size.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
